title: The Morning Digest: October 12, 2026
dek: Trump posted Sunday that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to an "energy ceasefire" effective immediately, no terms, Russia silent, Zelenskiy awaiting details and offering conditional acceptance. The overnight tape sold about $1.50 on both legs on the announcement. But the Gulf war widened Sunday: US forces struck Iranian military sites near the Strait for the second straight night, and three more tankers were hit, including the MT Petro Dolphin drone strike at Sohar with two crew missing. The Houthi airport campaign is now lethal: 12 dead and 309 injured at Riyadh airport Saturday, a second attack Sunday, and Dammam airport hit. The diesel crack held above $100 at $102.73. ICE (Oct 9): TMW Nov26 -$24.78, Dec26 -$25.60 still the widest tenor. The SPR 40 Mbbl exchange award is still pending.
